content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with a [product_name] [version_no]. After activating SD card copy protection, I noticed that retentive variables are no longer retained. Upon power reset, setpoints revert to their default block values. This issue does not occur with previous hardware versions like [version_no]. Could anyone clarify what might be causing this?
The resolution is to update the firmware. [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced loss of retentivity and reset of setpoints to default values following power cycles after enabling SD card copy protection on [product_name] [version_no]. This problem did not exist in older hardware versions, suggesting the issue is firmware-related and can be resolved with a firmware update.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that setpoints and retentive values remain intact after a power reset, even when SD card copy protection is enabled.
